product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic provides enterprise teams with an AI-enabled digital asset management platform to organize, govern, collaborate on, and distribute content and automate associated workflows.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page was found on the company website; /pricing returned no page and the contact page offers a demo, not plans. A separate AWS Marketplace listing publishes contract pricing.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is product and marketing content; architecture articles were found, but not two posts about building the product by identified engineers.

public_docs.notes: Public developer portal includes multiple API guides, references, scripting documentation, and a changelog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Applied AI Product Engineer.

model_provider.notes: September 8, 2026 announcement states Orange Logic is embedding NVIDIA Nemotron open models in Agent Studio.

compliance_certs.notes: The page names SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 as assurance standards, and HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS as regulatory coverage; these are public compliance claims, not a claim that every item is a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: Bregal Sagemount strategic growth investment, announced May 16, 2023. Amount was not publicly disclosed, so amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is May 16, 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; the funding profile updated October 11, 2026 still lists it as the latest round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable official board lists open positions but no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Orange Builder was unveiled September 30, 2026 as an AI-native brand-site builder, with preview/early access rather than general availability.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Derek Coles’s profile records his start as Vice President of Sales in December 2025, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot marketing automation and CRM expertise is explicitly required in the Marketing Operations Manager job copy. Salesforce Marketing Cloud is a documented product integration, not proof of internal deployment; Salesforce, Marketo and Pardot are only preferred prior experience and are not treated as confirmed internal systems.
